subject: maths
question: If books bought at prices ranging from ₹200 to ₹260 are sold at prices ranging from ₹250 to 300, what is the greatest possible profit that might be made in selling 25 books?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To obtain the greatest possible profit, the books must be bought at the lowest possible price and sold at the highest possible price.

Maximum Profit per book = Maximum Selling Price − Minimum Cost Price = 300 − 200 = ₹100.

Greatest profit for 25 books = 25 × 100 = ₹2500.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost price of books ranges from ₹200 to ₹260.

Selling price of books ranges from ₹250 to ₹300.

Total number of books to be sold = 25.

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Selling Price (SP) − Cost Price (CP)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3c0020f5229089d74880f16be856b5e5ec3b194e018934b47b3bffbd7e0048f.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ For maximum profit, the cost price must be the minimum possible and the selling price must be the maximum possible.

⇒ Minimum Cost Price (CP) of one book = ₹200

⇒ Maximum Selling Price (SP) of one book = ₹300

⇒ Maximum profit per book = Maximum SP − Minimum CP

⇒ Maximum profit per book = 300 − 200 = ₹100

⇒ Total greatest possible profit for 25 books = 25 × 100 = ₹2500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Maximum vs Minimum Profit

Maximum profit is obtained when the Cost Price is minimum and Selling Price is maximum. Conversely, minimum profit (or maximum loss) occurs when the Cost Price is maximum and Selling Price is minimum.

Profit and Loss Percentage

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100. Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100. Percentage is always calculated on the original Cost Price unless specified otherwise in the question.

Selling Price Formula

When Profit % is given: SP = CP × (100 + Profit %) ÷ 100. When Loss % is given: SP = CP × (100 − Loss %) ÷ 100.
